title: Query Active AGV Errors From the WCS Database
summary: Retrieve current active AGV error records from the WCS database by logging into the WCS primary server, opening the WCS database, creating a new query tab, entering the documented SQL query against [Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics].[dbo].[SystemActiveErrorModel], executing it, and reviewing the returned results.
when_to_use: Use this procedure when active AGV error records need to be retrieved from the WCS database for investigation or visibility.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a corrective action for AGV errors; the source only provides retrieval steps.
Do not use this procedure when WCS primary server or WCS database access is unavailable.

steps.title: Log into the WCS primary server
steps.instruction: Log into the WCS primary server.
steps.purpose: Access the source system environment used for the active AGV error query.
steps.expected_result: You are logged into the WCS primary server and can continue to the database access step.
steps.healthy_condition: The WCS primary server is accessible and the session is opened successfully.
steps.failure_condition: The WCS primary server cannot be accessed or login cannot be completed.
stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if access to the WCS primary server is not available.

actions.label: Log into WCS primary server
actions.exact_action: Log into the WCS primary server.

steps.purpose: Reach the database environment where the active AGV error query will be run.

steps.instruction: Open a new query tab by clicking the indicated control.

steps.instruction: Copy and paste the provided SQL query into the newly opened query tab.
steps.purpose: Enter the source-provided query that retrieves active AGV error records.
steps.expected_result: The query editor contains the documented SQL statement.
steps.healthy_condition: The full SQL query is visible in the new query tab.
steps.failure_condition: The query text is incomplete, missing, or cannot be entered into the query tab.

actions.label: Paste SQL query

steps.title: Use the documented active AGV error query text
steps.instruction: Use the provided query text exactly as documented: SELECT TOP (1000) [Id], [EntityInserted], [EntityLastUpdate], [Name], [Area], [Error], [LastSeen], [SystemErrorDescription], [SystemErrorResolution] FROM [Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics].[dbo].[SystemActiveErrorModel].
steps.purpose: Ensure the query matches the source-defined table and selected fields for active AGV errors.
steps.expected_result: The query text references the documented fields and the [Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics].[dbo].[SystemActiveErrorModel] table.
steps.healthy_condition: The query includes Id, EntityInserted, EntityLastUpdate, Name, Area, Error, LastSeen, SystemErrorDescription, and SystemErrorResolution from [Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics].[dbo].[SystemActiveErrorModel].
steps.failure_condition: The query text does not match the documented fields or does not reference the documented table.
stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the documented query text cannot be confirmed or does not match the source.

actions.label: Verify query text
actions.exact_action: Use the provided query text: SELECT TOP (1000) [Id], [EntityInserted], [EntityLastUpdate], [Name], [Area], [Error], [LastSeen], [SystemErrorDescription], [SystemErrorResolution] FROM [Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics].[dbo].[SystemActiveErrorModel].

steps.title: Execute the query
steps.instruction: Right click on the query and click execute.
steps.purpose: Run the documented SQL statement to retrieve active AGV error records.
steps.expected_result: The query runs and the interface proceeds to display returned results.
steps.healthy_condition: The query executes without blocking the results display.
steps.failure_condition: The query cannot be executed or execution does not produce a results display.
stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the query cannot be executed.

actions.label: Execute query
actions.exact_action: Right click on the query and click execute.

steps.title: Review the results area
steps.instruction: Review the results area where the active errors appear.
steps.purpose: Confirm where the active AGV error records are displayed after query execution.
steps.expected_result: A results area displays the active AGV errors returned by the query.
steps.healthy_condition: The results panel or table is visible and populated with active error records.
steps.failure_condition: The results area does not display returned active errors.
stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the results area does not display returned active errors.

actions.label: Review results area
actions.exact_action: Review the results area where the active errors appear.

steps.title: Check the returned fields in the results
steps.instruction: Check the returned fields in the results, including Id, EntityInserted, EntityLastUpdate, Name, Area, Error, LastSeen, SystemErrorDescription, and SystemErrorResolution.
steps.purpose: Verify that the returned active AGV error records include the documented fields needed for investigation.
steps.expected_result: The results include the documented identifier, timestamp, area, error, description, and resolution fields.
steps.healthy_condition: Returned records show Id, EntityInserted, EntityLastUpdate, Name, Area, Error, LastSeen, SystemErrorDescription, and SystemErrorResolution.
